summary: Suppress near-duplicate active alerts during POST creation using a configurable time window and return the existing alert when suppression occurs.

acceptance_criteria.text: On POST /api/alerts, if an active alert with the same Title (case-insensitive) and Severity was created within the configured suppression window, do not create a new row and instead return the existing alert.
When duplicate suppression occurs, return 200 OK with the existing alert and response header X-Duplicate-Suppressed: true.
A genuinely new alert still returns 201 Created, and suppression must not occur across different severities or when the prior matching alert is inactive.
The suppression window must be configurable from appsettings.json rather than hardcoded, with the story's baseline value set to 15 minutes.

constraints: Maintain the existing controller -> service -> repository layering.
Match duplicate titles case-insensitively but only within the same severity.
Suppress only when the prior matching alert is active and inside the configured window.
Do not hardcode the suppression window; source it from configuration.
Preserve the existing create contract for non-suppressed alerts: 201 Created with CreatedAtRoute.
coverage_goals: Cover controller status code and header behavior for suppressed versus newly created alerts.
Cover service orchestration for duplicate detection, suppression decisions, and configurable window usage.
Cover repository duplicate lookup rules for active state, title case-insensitivity, severity matching, and time-window boundaries.
